```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(qiime2R)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```



```{r}
fmt_qiime<-qza_to_phyloseq(features="FMT-table-combined_v3.qza",
                       tree="rooted-tree-merged-combined.qza",
                       metadata="MT_MAmice_metadata_v3.txt", 
                       taxonomy = "FMT-taxonomy-silva138-weighted-combined.qza")
fmt_qiime
fmt_qiime<-prune_taxa(taxa_sums(fmt_qiime) > 0, fmt_qiime)
print(order(sample_sums(fmt_qiime)))
```
#Samples summary
```{r}
samples_fmt_df<-as.data.frame(sample_data(fmt_qiime))
metadata_summ_fmt <- samples_fmt_df %>%
  group_by(age_type, host_sex, generation, MT) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop")
View(metadata_summ_fmt)

ggplot(metadata_summ_fmt, aes(fill=host_sex, y=n_samples, x=age_type)) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("deeppink","blue","grey"))+
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+facet_wrap(.~MT+generation, scales="free", nrow=4)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))
```


# FMT from aged mice to GF
```{r}
metadata_fmt<-as.data.frame(sample_data(fmt_qiime))
metadata_fmt$SampleID<-rownames(metadata_fmt)
metadata_fmt<-as.matrix(metadata_fmt)

fmt_qiime_rare<-rarefy_even_depth(fmt_qiime,sample.size = min(sample_sums(fmt_qiime))) #Min was 7283

alpha.div.fmt.df <- estimate_richness(
  fmt_qiime_rare, 
  measures=c("Shannon", "Observed","Chao1","Simpson")) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>% 
  merge(metadata_fmt, by="SampleID")

alpha.div.long.fmt.df <- alpha.div.fmt.df %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(Shannon, Observed), names_to="metric")

# summarize across sexes

alpha.div.plot.fmt.df <- alpha.div.long.fmt.df %>% 
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% c("Shannon")) %>% 
  
  # compute mean and SD across diets (separately for each metric)
  group_by(metric, generation, MT, age_type)

alpha.div.plot.fmt.df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_type, y = value,
    color = generation
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(stat="boxplot") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric+host_sex, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("deeppink", "blue")) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (months)",
    y = "",
    title = "Alpha diversity ASV method (Y axis not at 0)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
```{r}
#alpha.div.plot.fmt.df<-read.delim("alpha-fmt-df.txt")
alpha.div.plot.fmt.df %>%
   ggplot(aes(
     x = age_type, y = value,
     color = MT
   )) +
   geom_boxplot(width = 0.6,position = position_dodge2(width = 0.7, preserve = "single")) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
facet_wrap(~metric+generation, scales = "free", nrow=2)+
   scale_color_manual(values = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa", "#aa3377", "#619cff","grey")) +
   labs(
     x = "Age (months)",
     y = "",
     title = "Alpha diversity ASV method (Y axis not at 0)"
   ) +
   theme_bw()
```
## Beta Diversity
```{r}
subset_F1_F2<-subset_samples(fmt_qiime, generation  %in% c("F2","F1"))

subset_F1_F2<-subset_samples(subset_F1_F2, age_type  %in% c("D_middle_aged","B_post_weaning", "A_weaning"))
subset_F1_F2<-subset_samples(subset_F1_F2, MT %in% c("AFM1","AMM","YFM","YMM"))
subset_F1_F2<-prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_F1_F2) > 0, subset_F1_F2)

fmt_norm<-  fmt_qiime %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))

subset_F1_F2_norm<-subset_F1_F2 %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))

subset_F1_F2_bdist.ord.fmt <- ordinate(subset_F1_F2_norm, "PCoA", "bray")

plot_ordination(subset_F1_F2_norm, subset_F1_F2_bdist.ord.fmt, color="MT", title="Bray Curtis", shape = "age_type_gen") +
    geom_point(aes(fill=MT,color = MT, shape = age_type_gen), size = 4) +  # size outside aes()
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa", "#aa3377", "#619cff","black")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa", "#aa3377", "#619cff","black")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,21, 2, 24,13)) +  # Add shape scale (fillable shapes) 
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size=14), axis.title = element_text(size=15)) +
    guides(
        fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)),
        color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)),
        shape = guide_legend(),
        alpha = guide_legend(),
        size = "none"  # Remove size legend since it's constant
    ) +stat_ellipse(aes(group = age_type), linewidth = 1) 
```
```{r}
bdist.ord.fmt_df <- as.data.frame(bdist.ord.fmt$vectors[,1:3])
bdist.ord.fmt_df$MT <- sample_data(subset_F1_F2)$MT
bdist.ord.fmt_df$age_type_gen <- sample_data(subset_F1_F2)$age_type_gen
bdist.ord.fmt_df$generation <- sample_data(fmt_qiime)$generation

plot_ly(bdist.ord.fmt_df, 
        x = ~Axis.1, y = ~Axis.2, z = ~Axis.3,
        color = ~MT,
        colors = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa", "#aa3377", "#619cff"),
        symbol = ~age_type_gen,  # Use 'symbol' instead of 'shape'
        symbols = c('circle', 'square', 'cross', 'triangle-up'),  # Define symbols
        type = "scatter3d", 
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 4)) %>%
    layout(title = "3D Bray-Curtis Ordination (PCoA)")
```
```{r adonis}

samples_fmt_df_full<-as.matrix(sample_data(fmt_norm))
samples_fmt_df_full<-as.data.frame(samples_fmt_df_full)

bray_dist_matrix_fmt_full<-phyloseq::distance(fmt_norm, method ="bray")
```

```{r}
adonis2(bray_dist_matrix_fmt_full ~ MT+generation+age_type+host_sex, data = samples_fmt_df_full, permutations = 999, by="margin")
```
```{r}
adonis2(bray_dist_matrix_fmt_full ~ Donor_Age+Donor_sex+generation+month_age+host_sex, data = samples_fmt_df_full, permutations = 999, by="margin")
```

```{r}
subset_AFM <- subset_samples(fmt_qiime, MT %in% c("AMM"))
subset_AFM<-prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_AFM) > 0, subset_AFM)

#normalize
subset_AFM_norm<-transform_sample_counts(subset_AFM,function(x) x / sum(x))

otu_data_afm1<-otu_table(subset_AFM_norm)
otu_data_afm1<-as.matrix(otu_data_afm1)
otu_data_afm1<-as.data.frame(otu_data_afm1)

otu_data_afm1_filt <- otu_data_afm1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)) > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE) >= 2)
otu_data_afm1_filt$ASV<-rownames(otu_data_afm1_filt)

tdf_fmt<-as.data.frame(tax_table(fmt_qiime))
tdf_fmt$ASV<-rownames(tdf_fmt)
otu_data_afm1_tax<-merge(otu_data_afm1_filt,tdf_fmt, by="ASV")

otu_data_afm1_tax_filt2<- otu_data_afm1_tax %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus %in% c("Turicibacter","Bacteroides","Bifidobacterium","Faecalibaculum","Lactobacillus"))

otu_data_afm1_tax_long <- otu_data_afm1_tax_filt2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ASV, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

otu_data_afm1_tax_long<-merge(otu_data_afm1_tax_long,metadata_fmt, by="SampleID")

otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2<- otu_data_afm1_tax_long %>%
  group_by(age_type, generation, Genus, Family, sex) %>%
  summarise(n_samples   = dplyr::n(),
    median_abund = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abund     = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") 

otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2$gen_age<- paste(otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2$generation,otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2$age_type, sep = "_")

otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2$gen_age <- factor(
  otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2$gen_age,
  levels = c(
    "Donor_A_Donor", "F0_B_post_weaning", "F0_C_young",
    "F0_D_middle_aged", "F1_AA_weaning","F1_B_post_weaning", "F1_C_young", "F1_D_middle_aged","F2_AA_weaning","F2_B_post_weaning","F2_C_young"
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)
  
otu_data_afm1_tax_long_v2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=gen_age, y=median_abund, color=sex,  ymin = median_abund - sd_abund, ymax = median_abund + sd_abund))+

  geom_pointrange(alpha = 0.7) +
facet_wrap(~ Genus, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))
```

#Plot rel_abund all MTs
```{r}

#normalize
subset_norm<-transform_sample_counts(fmt_qiime,function(x) x / sum(x))

otu_data1<-otu_table(subset_norm)
otu_data1<-as.matrix(otu_data1)
otu_data1<-as.data.frame(otu_data1)

otu_data1_filt <- otu_data1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)) > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE) >= 3)
otu_data1_filt$ASV<-rownames(otu_data1_filt)

tdf_fmt<-as.data.frame(tax_table(fmt_qiime))
tdf_fmt$ASV<-rownames(tdf_fmt)
otu_data1_tax<-merge(otu_data1_filt,tdf_fmt, by="ASV")

otu_data1_tax_long <- otu_data1_tax %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ASV, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

otu_data1_tax_long<-merge(otu_data1_tax_long,metadata_fmt, by="SampleID")

otu_data1_tax_long_v2<- otu_data1_tax_long %>%
  group_by(age_type, generation, Genus, Family, MT, sex) %>%
  summarise(n_samples   = dplyr::n(),
            median_abund = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_abund     = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") 

otu_data1_tax_long_v2$gen_age<- paste(otu_data1_tax_long_v2$generation,otu_data1_tax_long_v2$age_type, sep = "_")

otu_data1_tax_long_v2$gen_age <- factor(
  otu_data1_tax_long_v2$gen_age,
  levels = c(
    "Donor_A_Donor", "F0_B_post_weaning", "F0_C_young",
    "F0_D_middle_aged","F1_AA_weaning","F1_B_post_weaning", "F1_C_young", "F1_D_middle_aged","F2_AA_weaning","F2_B_post_weaning","F2_C_young"
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)

otu_data1_tax_long_v2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=gen_age, y=median_abund, color=sex,  ymin = median_abund - sd_abund, ymax = median_abund + sd_abund))+
  geom_path(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_pointrange(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Genus+MT, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))
```

## Plot rel abund based on maaslin comparison

```{r}
maas_res_fmt<-read_excel("maaslin_results_fmt.xlsx")

maas_res_fmt <- maas_res_fmt[!duplicated(maas_res_fmt$feature), ]
maas_res_fmt<- maas_res_fmt[c(1)]

maas_res_fmt<-merge(maas_res_fmt,otu_data1_filt, by.x="feature",by.y="ASV")


maas_res_fmt_tax<-merge(maas_res_fmt,tdf_fmt, by.x="feature",by.y="ASV")

otu_data1_tax_long <- maas_res_fmt_tax %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(feature, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

otu_data1_tax_long<-merge(otu_data1_tax_long,metadata_fmt, by="SampleID")

otu_data1_tax_long_v2<- otu_data1_tax_long %>%
  group_by(age_type, generation, Genus, Family, MT) %>%
  summarise(n_samples   = dplyr::n(),
            median_abund = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_abund     = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") 

otu_data1_tax_long_v2$gen_age<- paste(otu_data1_tax_long_v2$generation,otu_data1_tax_long_v2$age_type, sep = "_")

otu_data1_tax_long_v2$gen_age <- factor(
  otu_data1_tax_long_v2$gen_age,
  levels = c(
    "Donor_A_Donor", "F0_B_post_weaning", "F0_C_young",
    "F0_D_middle_aged","F1_AA_weaning","F1_B_post_weaning", "F1_C_young", "F1_D_middle_aged","F2_AA_weaning","F2_B_post_weaning","F2_C_young"
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)

otu_data1_tax_long_v2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=gen_age, y=median_abund, color=MT,  ymin = median_abund - sd_abund, ymax = median_abund + sd_abund))+
  geom_path(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_pointrange(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Genus, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))
```

# How does FMT samples compare to other aged mice
```{r}
fmt_wAging_qiime<-qza_to_phyloseq(features="FMT-table-combined-with-Aging_v4.qza",
                       tree="rooted-tree-merged-combined.qza",
                       metadata="MT_OG_metadata.txt", 
                       taxonomy = "Aging-taxonomy-weighted_silva138-1.qza")
fmt_wAging_qiime
```
```{r}
fmt_aging_norm<-  fmt_wAging_qiime %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))

fmt_aging_norm<-rarefy_even_depth(fmt_wAging_qiime,sample.size = min(sample_sums(fmt_wAging_qiime)))

bdist.ord.fmt.age <- ordinate(fmt_aging_norm, "PCoA", "bray")

plot_ordination(fmt_aging_norm, bdist.ord.fmt.age, color="MT", title="Bray Curtis") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = MT), size = 4) +  # size outside aes()
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa","darkgreen","grey","black", "#aa3377", "#619cff")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa","darkgreen","grey","black", "#aa3377", "#619cff")) +
    #scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24, 23, 20)) +  # Add shape scale (fillable shapes)
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
    guides(
        fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)),
        color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)),
        shape = guide_legend(),
        alpha = guide_legend(),
        size = "none"  # Remove size legend since it's constant
    ) 
```
```{r}
bdist.ord.fmt.age_df <- as.data.frame(bdist.ord.fmt.age$vectors[,1:3])
bdist.ord.fmt.age_df$MT <- sample_data(fmt_aging_norm)$MT


plot_ly(bdist.ord.fmt.age_df, 
        x = ~Axis.1, y = ~Axis.2, z = ~Axis.3,
        color = ~MT,
        colors = c("#f8766d", "#4477aa","darkgreen","grey","black", "#aa3377", "#619cff"),
        #symbol = ~generation,  # Use 'symbol' instead of 'shape'
        #symbols = c('circle', 'square', 'diamond', 'cross', 'triangle-up'),  # Define symbols
        type = "scatter3d", 
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 4)) %>%
    layout(title = "3D Bray-Curtis Ordination (PCoA)")
```

#Beta dispersion
```{r}
bray_dist_fmt<-phyloseq::distance(fmt_norm, method = "bray")
metadata_fmt$SampleID<-rownames(metadata_fmt)

bd_fmt <- betadisper(bray_dist_fmt, metadata_fmt$MT)
bd_df_fmt <- data.frame(
  Distance = bd_fmt$distances,
  MT = metadata_fmt$MT,
  age=metadata_fmt$age_type, 
  mouse= metadata_fmt$mouse,
  generation=metadata_fmt$generation
)

#Optional to make a line plot with medians
median_fmt_df <- bd_df %>%
  group_by(Sex, Month) %>%
  summarise(median_distance = median(Distance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

anova(bd_fmt)
```
```{r}
ggplot(bd_df_fmt, aes(x = MT, y = Distance, fill = age)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Beta Dispersion by Month and Sex",
       x = "Month", y = "Distance to Group Centroid") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")+facet_grid(~generation)
```
